verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine payments that let agents pay for APIs and services programmatically, with stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol (minimum 0.01 USDC). An official MCP server also gives agents tools to call the Stripe API. However, the evidence never shows human-configured spend controls or scoped authority over what an agent can spend, and it does not document agent-initiated stablecoin payouts. missing for 10: documented human-configured spend limits/scoped agent authority, agent-initiated stablecoin payout flows, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent stablecoin payments.
